title: Prospective behavioural prediction and spatially resolved hippocampal proteomics in adolescent social-instability stress
what_it_claims: Names the two halves of the study and the paradigm. Asserts no relationship between them.
why_accepted_or_rejected: SELECTED. The Discussion states plainly that the work yields three separate findings about one cohort and that no evidence joins the behavioural result to the proteomic one. A title that named a single headline result would have to pick one half and would invite the reader to supply the missing link; a title that joined them with a verb would assert exactly the chain the manuscript refuses to claim. A study-descriptive title is the only form that is both informative and true here. Prospective is licensed by claim C1-1 and C1-8.
wording_rules_checked: No region-specific, layer-specific, selective or restricted. No hotspot. No burden score. No causal verb between behaviour and proteome. Prediction is qualified as prospective, which the frozen timeline contract supports.

title: Early home-cage activity predicts later stress outcome, and hippocampal proteomic differences are sparse at the protein level and coordinated at the program level
what_it_claims: Both headline results, stated separately and joined only by and.
why_accepted_or_rejected: Rejected on length, not on accuracy. At 161 characters it exceeds the title limit of most target journals, and the two-clause construction reads as a contrast the manuscript does not draw. Retained here because it is the most complete one-line statement of what the paper found, and is a usable basis for a cover letter or a summary sentence.
wording_rules_checked: Same checks passed. And is deliberately the only connective; no because, no therefore, no through.

title: Spatially resolved hippocampal proteomics of resilience and susceptibility after adolescent social-instability stress
why_accepted_or_rejected: Rejected. Drops the behavioural result entirely, including Figure 1 and the whole of Results 1, and would make the prospective prediction look like supporting material for a proteomics paper rather than one of three findings. It also foregrounds the resilient and susceptible labels, which are defined by the composite score rather than measured independently.
wording_rules_checked: Passed, but the omission is the problem rather than the wording.

title: Early spontaneous activity predicts later stress outcome in adolescent mice
why_accepted_or_rejected: Rejected for the mirror-image reason: it describes Figure 1 and nothing else, and no part of it signals that the study is a spatial proteomic one. It is the shortest and most quotable candidate and is recorded for that reason.
